title: Oozing Spicy Chinese Bacon Soup
description: A velvety, low‑calorie wonton soup with smoky bacon and fiery chili, perfect for midnight cravings.
instructions: Heat the earthenware pot over medium heat and add the bacon lardon, cooking until slightly crispy.
Remove the bacon and set aside, leaving the rendered fat in the pot.
Add the ginger, garlic, and dried chili flakes to the pot and stir for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Pour in the chicken stock, soy sauce, and rice vinegar, and bring the mixture to a gentle boil.
Whisk the egg in a small bowl, then drizzle it slowly into the simmering broth while stirring gently to create silky ribbons.
Mix the ground pork, a pinch of salt, pepper, and the egg ribbons together, then spoon the mixture into the wonton wrappers.
Fold the wrappers into small triangles, sealing the edges with a little water.
Carefully drop the formed wontons into the simmering broth and cook for 4 minutes until they float and the filling is cooked through.
Add the reserved bacon lardon pieces back into the pot and heat for another minute.
Serve the soup hot, garnished with sliced scallions, and drizzle with a splash of sesame oil before eating.
